\r\n

Blade

\r\n
\r\n\r\n
\r\n \r\n
\r\n
\r\n

Blade

\r\n
\r\n

There are 3 sizes available - please pass the bladeSize value into the component, these are: one-column-width, two-column-width, or xl-column-width

\r\n

For pinning, set [enablePinning] to true. Then add a conditional [ngStyle] to the content-container.\r\n Modify the calculated width depending on the blade size you are using.\r\n In the example below, we are setting the width for a one-column-width blade

\r\n

[ngStyle]=“{‘width’: toggleBlade && pinBlade ? ‘calc(100% - 38rem)’ : ‘ ’ }”

\r\n

These setting are adjustable.

\r\n
\r\n

Blade - custom header/footer

\r\n
\r\n

If you need to customise the blade header and/or footer please use the below \r\n version of the Blade and remember to set [customBlade] to true.\r\n
